lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Bi2Sn2 (reduced formula Mg6BiSn) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Bi and Sn each have 12 geometric neighbors, while Mg centers also show 12 neighbors across several environments. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component containing all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Mg polyhedra, with edge- and face-sharing also observed between Bi and Mg polyhedra.
